description: List the objects of a namespace (the list verb of Media's namespace grants, WS-G task 2): a Network token sees only the namespaces its ns covers, and ?namespace= narrows the list to one namespace and those below it. The same verb guards the job list (GET /api/v2/:app/jobs), the namespace list with quotas and usage (GET /api/v2/:app/namespaces) and the v1 file list (GET /api/v1/:app/files). media.object.read also grants it, for tokens issued before the verbs were split, unless the namespace's policy is strict_verbs.
